title: Kyushu Udon Stew
description: A hearty Japanese stew made with Kyushu udon noodles, beef, and vegetables.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in 2 cups of beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Add the Kyushu udon noodles and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they are cooked through.
Stir in chopped chives and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with additional chives, if desired.
